pages.title: Transcendental Ore
pages.text: Axiom stone shot through with crystals of transcendental numbers - pi, e and their kin, which are not roots of any polynomial. The veins never repeat and never end. It is cool and faintly bright. Its sparkle never repeats.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Deep in the axiom stone I found crystals whose patterns never repeated. Testing them, I found they were transcendental. I keep a sample in my notebook as a reminder.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the Platonic Realm (mine it for its drop).
